verdict.rationale: Reclaim's Smart Meetings are documented to 'find the best time to meet across all attendees' schedules' and are part of its priority-based auto-scheduling. Docs also say it automatically reschedules events when conflicts arise. Smart Meetings auto-lock at 4am on the day they occur, which implies they keep moving to better slots until then. missing for 10: detailed docs on how attendee-wide optimization ranks slots beyond first-available, explicit first-party description of continuous re-optimization for multi-attendee meetings, independent or hands-on corroboration of Smart Meetings.
